correctness.rationale: Each incoming column is an initial segment ending at d_j<=j, or empty. If r=d_j>=0, a factorization of the last edge rRj must use an intermediate k with r<=k<=d_j=r; hence r has a loop. Conversely such a loop and prefix closure factor every incoming edge through r, proving the exact criterion. Transitivity independently follows from prefix closure and strongness. Grouping by column endpoint produces the nonstar blocks with their minima as roots, and the empty columns form the block containing the star. The inverse from partitions has the required endpoint bounds and loops. Seriality is exactly a loop at n-1 and hence a singleton top block; deleting the singleton gives the stated rank shift, also for n=1. For an upset U, factoring each edge through a root and using upward closure proves the modal formula; testing U={i+1,...,n-1} distinguishes whether i is a root. In threshold coordinates U_a={i:i>=a}, with a=n allowed, the nucleus sends a to one plus the largest root below a, or 0 if none exists. Its fixed thresholds are 0 and r+1 for r in S. Conversely, any specified fixed thresholds containing 0 yield such a closure on the chain; monotonicity gives binary meet preservation. For a prescribed S the nonroot columns choose independently among earlier roots or the empty value, yielding the stated product. The literal finite enumeration used by verify_dense_chains.py was inspected, not executed; the all-n proof is independent of the n<=7 checks. This does not classify branching frames or count distinct modal logics.
